findings.title: Definite expired pre-reserve startup leaves an H2 retirement record
findings.effect: Missing live spawn token yields stale_generation for proof; retirement consumes a stream slot and retries every10ms until connection closure.
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed specific pre-reserve rejection path; runtime reproduction NOT RUN.
findings.required_regression: Expired pre-reserve worker admission clears retirement; another stream succeeds on the same connection.
findings.proof_boundary: Do not treat every later or ambiguous deadline outcome as absence of reservation.

disposition: Affected implementation frozen; explicit additional repair budget pending.

reservation_review.profile_limitation: Remaining envelope fixed across TCP/TLS and SSL internal_active_n1..100; necessity of eight TLS100 delivery/copy envelopes for every profile unproven.
reservation_review.controlled_fixture_limitation: Fake TCP socket and scalar accounting; exact finite cap funds production arithmetic but does not prove real network obligations.
reservation_review.disposition: No unnecessary worst-case idle reservation compliance remains open; do not infer it from passing concurrency tests.

deadline_proof_limitation: Post-reserve activate_spawn can also return deadline_exceeded (admission.ex:855); blanket deadline allowlisting is unsafe.
